subject: Food Science
title: COVID and Taste Loss
description: A quick win: understand COVID and Taste Loss.

hook.text: 60% of COVID-19 patients lost their sense of smell. Many reported that all food tasted the same—bland, metallic, or absent.

buildup.text: SARS-CoV-2 infects sustentacular cells that support olfactory neurons. The neurons survive but lose support.

discovery.text: Most patients recover smell within weeks. But 10–15% experience parosmia—distorted smell where normal foods smell like garbage or.

twist.text: Parosmia patients often find coffee, meat, and onions repulsive—their most recognizable aromas become the most distorted during.

climax.text: Smell training—sniffing rose, lemon, clove, and eucalyptus daily—accelerates recovery.

punchline.text: COVID revealed how much we depend on smell for food enjoyment.

quiz.question: What is parosmia?
options: Distorted smell—normal foods smell like garbage or chemicals during COVID recovery
